title: Pro Gen3D Bearing Family
description: ProGen3D | Bearing family 1.0.0 | Y-axis shaft, origin at the centre of the bearing.
detail: ProGen3D | Bearing family 1.0.0 | Y-axis shaft, origin at the centre of the bearing. · Change the Start rule to a named preset below, or call Bearing directly. · Bearing(family bore outside width element count rollerLength front rear) · Enter lengths in millimetres. Output geometry uses metres. · family: 0 deep-groove ball, 1 cylindrical roller, 2 needle roller, 3 thrust ball, 4 plain sleeve. · bore = shaft-hole diameter; outside = housing-seat diameter; width = axial width. · element = ball or roller diameter; count = rolling elements in the single row. · rollerLength = axial length for families 1/2; use zero for 68 percent of bearing width. · front (+Y) and rear (-Y) are independent: 0 open, 1 metal shield, 2 elastomer seal. · Use open faces for thrust and sleeve. Sleeve uses only bore, outside and width.
